column1: # Niagara Drift's words for the screen reader (Charles Vestal's fm1-reader): the screen's text <TAB> what to say.
# "#" a number, "*" a word left out. tools/gen_words.py makes web/words/<id>.json (published with the site) and the
# link the FM-1 sends. Change a line and a new file is made: keep the old ones (FM-1s in the wild point at them).
